name: fNIRS ML classification benchmarking framework
description: Provides a standardized framework and evaluation protocol to compare machine learning classifiers on fNIRS (functional near-infrared spectroscopy) time-series data for classification tasks.
reputation: Niche benchmarking framework known in the neuroimaging / fNIRS community for standardizing comparisons but with limited broad adoption outside the field.
notes: Common caveats include small sample sizes and high inter-subject variability in fNIRS data, susceptibility to motion and physiological artifacts, and the need for rigorous cross-validation; this is a non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark.
